Players Committee card image of [[Captain Lando Calrissian]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a battle was just initiated here, may exchange a card in hand with an Interrupt of destiny = 4 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, if you have completed a Kessel Run, may return Lando to hand.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Captain%20Lando%20Calrissian.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Captain Lando Calrissian.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
